conflicts.permit: In particular, consistent with the CCPA, if we knowingly collect the California Information of a consumer under the age of 16, we will not sell the information unless we receive affirmative permission to do so.
conflicts.prohibit: WE DO NOT SELL YOUR CALIFORNIA INFORMATION
conflicts.situation: Selling California personal information of a consumer under the age of 16 who (or whose parent) provides affirmative permission to sell.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly asserts in an absolute heading/statement that it does not sell California Information, but subsequently specifies conditions under which it will sell it with affirmative permission.
